method_fidelity_checklist.definition: Replace conventional MLP linear transformations with Fourier series-based univariate function compositions per the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem

key_structural_ingredients.fourier_basis: Cosine and sine functions at multiple harmonic frequencies
key_structural_ingredients.residual_linear: Linear weight matrix and bias as residual connection
key_structural_ingredients.frequency_scaling: Base frequencies scaled by factor of 2 for coverage

integration_points.KA-GCN: KAN replaces linear transform in GCN message-passing normalization step
integration_points.KA-GAT: KAN replaces source and destination linear projections in GAT attention mechanism

assumptions: Input features are suitable for Fourier expansion without explicit normalization to [0,1]
Batch normalization provides sufficient input scaling
deviations: Used fixed frequency scaling (2k) rather than learnable frequencies - simplification for stability
Combined Fourier coefficients into single einsum operation rather than separate per-harmonic computation - efficiency optimization
Residual linear connection added to prevent gradient vanishing - practical necessity
invariants_checked: Fourier basis functions are continuous and differentiable - YES
Message passing preserves graph structure - YES
Attention mechanism maintains softmax normalization - YES
